protocol_name: Outcome-unseen validation of CCA family-first neighborhood borrowing
status: protocol template; no target selected and no outcomes accessed
purpose: Independently test whether credibility-gated, complementary, abstaining, family-first borrowing improves distinct-region OOD exploration.

forbidden_before_freeze: target-outcome correlations with any source prediction
policy hit rates or acquisition curves
manual inspection of high-outcome candidate identities
target_selection.minimum_target: at least 100 candidate entities in at least 40 outcome-free components and at least 20 provenance groups
target_selection.preferred_replication: one physically adjacent expected-positive target and one distant or wrong-neighborhood target selected from metadata only

source_admission.neighbor_count: at least two physically nominated sources
source_admission.leakage: exclude exact target entities and target DOI/provenance groups from every source fit
source_admission.credibility: freeze grouped source quality, target-development incremental information, and abstention thresholds before candidate outcomes

fixed_policy.fusion: unweighted rank sum for consensus plus source-specific round-robin audit
fixed_policy.family_first: one first-pass representative per predeclared formula/provenance or composition-cluster component
fixed_policy.ood: scope, quota, or tie-breaker only; never a multiplicative reward
fixed_policy.abstention: zero allocation for a source that fails the frozen credibility threshold
fixed_policy.fallback: composition novelty and uniform allocation remain active safety channels

co_primary: AUC of cumulative first recovery of distinct top-5-percent components through acquisition 20
acquisitions to first distinct top-5-percent component
required_tradeoff: marginal distinct components contributed by each source
sensitivities: component value defined by maximum, median, and mean target outcome
composition-cluster definition fixed at two outcome-free resolutions

inference.unit: independent target dataset, article block, or prospective campaign block; seed variation alone is insufficient
inference.randomization: independently shuffle every admitted source rank within the fixed candidate pool
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction over co-primary policy contrasts within each target
required_contrasts: CCA versus best admitted single source

success_rule.breadth: positive practically meaningful distinct-component AUC20 gain over uniform, novelty, and the best single admitted source
success_rule.specificity: practical separation from wrong-source and shuffled-source portfolios
success_rule.robustness: same direction under at least two component-value definitions and no reversal on the second target or independent article/campaign block
success_rule.science: at least one source-specific hypothesis card written before target reveal and tested against a frozen matched control
success_rule.failure: retain a null or harmful result as an abstention edge in the borrowing map

audit_sentinels: hash target metadata before outcome access
hash source predictions and all policy orders before outcome access
record excluded formula and DOI overlaps
archive code, environment, source data, and result hashes
